svg.title: Two NEUC jet width ranges at134.3E
svg.desc: Southern jet near9.6N:100-350km; northern jet near13.1N:0-200km. Source-reported multi-year ranges from2009-2014, not annual envelopes or uncertainty. Zero is a source lower bound, not missing data. Southern broad cases may combine jets. No dated width samples or new current boundaries.

g.text: North–south extent of eastward geostrophic flow; density context26.7–27.3kg/m³.
Above300km: possible combined jets; not isolated edges at every section.
Zero is the reported range endpoint. It does not supply a dated disappearance.
These are different local jets, not one0–350km current envelope.
No mean width, width error, annual extrema or seasonal animation inferred.
Density levels are not fixed metre depths. Core excursions are not width edges.
Primary HTML inspected; no original file retained. Own scalar figure; no field reproduction.
